<a id="conditionparser"></a>

## `ConditionParser`

static class · `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core.Conditions.ConditionParser` · assembly `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core`

Parses the condition grammar every pack file shares (EditData `when`, triggers, `cwy.if`). Syntax only: whether a token exists and what its values mean is the registry's and the evaluator's business ([`ConditionRegistry.Validate`](#conditionregistry--validate)).

The grammar (documented for authors in `Core/Conditions/README.md`):

```csharp
when        = JSON object; every member must hold (AND); an empty or absent object always holds
key         = token [ ":" argument ]          token = name | modId "/" name   (case-insensitive)
value       = string | number | boolean | array of those
string      = [ "!" ] alternative { "," alternative }   a leading "!" negates the whole list
array       = [ alternative, ... ]            one alternative per element, no commas split, no "!"
alternative = literal | low ".." high | (">=" | "<=" | ">" | "<") operand
```

Whitespace around keys and alternatives is ignored. Numbers and booleans become their invariant text (`5`, `12.5`, `true`). A range may run "backwards" (`22:00..06:00`): wrap-around is the evaluator's rule, not a syntax error.

<a id="conditionparser--maxargumentlength"></a>

### `const int MaxArgumentLength = 64`

Longest accepted argument (`flag:<name>`).

<a id="conditionparser--rangeseparator"></a>

### `const string RangeSeparator = ".."`

The range separator: `22..23`.

<a id="conditionparser--parse"></a>

<a id="conditionregistry"></a>

## `ConditionRegistry`

sealed class · `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core.Conditions.ConditionRegistry` · assembly `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core`

The condition tokens that exist, the evaluator that answers a [`ConditionSet`](#conditionset), and the [`ConditionsChanged`](#conditionschanged) channel. An ordinary object so it can be tested in isolation; [`ConditionRegistry.Shared`](#conditionregistry--shared) is the one the game uses (the plugins that contribute tokens are separate assemblies, as with `CommandRegistry.Shared`). Thread-safe.

Ownership rules: the framework ([`ConditionRegistry.FrameworkOwner`](#conditionregistry--frameworkowner)) registers bare names (the built-ins in [`ConditionTokens`](#conditiontokens)); a mod registers only `<its id>/<name>`. A name is never replaced: a second registration is refused until the first is disposed.

<a id="conditionregistry--ctor"></a>

Creates an empty registry with the unavailable evaluator.

<a id="conditiontokens"></a>

## `ConditionTokens`

static class · `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core.Conditions.ConditionTokens` · assembly `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core`

The built-in condition tokens (time of day, weekday, date range, pomodoro state, language, scenery, story progress, player level; the condition provider adds `hasPack`, `flag:<name>` and `random`). Only the framework may register these names; mods register `<modId>/<name>` tokens.

This table is the contract: the names, how values compare and when they change. The value vocabularies (which words `pomodoro` or `scenery` report) belong to the condition provider, which documents them in the author's guide.

<a id="conditiontokens--date"></a>

### `const string Date = "date"`

Local date.

<a id="conditiontokens--flag"></a>

### `const string Flag = "flag"`

A named flag: `flag:<name>`.

<a id="conditiontokens--haspack"></a>

### `const string HasPack = "hasPack"`

The ids of the loaded packs and code mods.

<a id="conditiontokens--hour"></a>

### `const string Hour = "hour"`

Local hour, 0-23.

<a id="conditiontokens--language"></a>

### `const string Language = "language"`

The display language code.

<a id="conditiontokens--level"></a>

### `const string Level = "level"`

The player's level.

<a id="conditiontokens--pomodoro"></a>

### `const string Pomodoro = "pomodoro"`

The timer's state.

<a id="conditiontokens--random"></a>

### `const string Random = "random"`

A roll 0-99.

<a id="conditiontokens--scenery"></a>

### `const string Scenery = "scenery"`

The active window views / scenery.

<a id="conditiontokens--story"></a>

### `const string Story = "story"`

The last main-story episode the player finished.

<a id="conditiontokens--time"></a>

### `const string Time = "time"`

Local clock time `HH:mm`; ranges may wrap past midnight.

<a id="conditiontokens--timeofday"></a>

### `const string TimeOfDay = "timeOfDay"`

The game's time of day.

<a id="conditiontokens--weekday"></a>

### `const string Weekday = "weekday"`

Day of the week.

<a id="conditiontokens--builtin"></a>

### `static IReadOnlyList<ConditionTokenInfo> BuiltIn { get; }`

Every built-in token, in the order above.

<a id="conditiontokens--isbuiltin"></a>

### `static bool IsBuiltIn(string name)`

True when `name` is a built-in token name (case-insensitive).

**Parameters**

- `name`: A token name without argument.

<a id="conditiontokens--trygetbuiltin"></a>

### `static bool TryGetBuiltIn(string name, out ConditionTokenInfo info)`

The built-in token with this name (case-insensitive).

**Parameters**

- `name`: A token name without argument.
- `info`: The token, or null.

<a id="conditionvaluekind"></a>

## `ConditionValueKind`

enum · `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core.Conditions.ConditionValueKind` · assembly `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core` · mod API

What kind of text a token's values are, so an evaluator knows how to compare them.

| Name | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="conditionvaluekind--text"></a>`Text` | 0 | Free text, compared case-insensitively (`th`, `work`, a pack id). |
| <a id="conditionvaluekind--integer"></a>`Integer` | 1 | A whole number in invariant culture (`22`). |
| <a id="conditionvaluekind--number"></a>`Number` | 2 | A number in invariant culture (`12.5`). |
| <a id="conditionvaluekind--time"></a>`Time` | 3 | A local clock time `HH:mm`; a range may wrap past midnight (`22:00..06:00`). |
| <a id="conditionvaluekind--date"></a>`Date` | 4 | A calendar date, `MM-dd` or `yyyy-MM-dd`; a range may wrap past New Year. |
| <a id="conditionvaluekind--weekday"></a>`Weekday` | 5 | A day of the week: `Mon` … `Sun` (or the full English name). |
| <a id="conditionvaluekind--boolean"></a>`Boolean` | 6 | `true` or `false`. |

<a id="iconditionevaluator"></a>

## `IConditionEvaluator`

interface · `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core.Conditions.IConditionEvaluator` · assembly `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core`

Answers a [`ConditionSet`](#conditionset) against the registered token sources. The framework installs one with [`ConditionRegistry.UseEvaluator`](#conditionregistry--useevaluator); until then [`UnavailableConditionEvaluator`](#unavailableconditionevaluator) answers.

<a id="iconditionevaluator--evaluate"></a>

### `ConditionResult Evaluate(ConditionSet conditions)`

Evaluates every clause (AND). Must not throw; the registry still guards it.

**Parameters**

- `conditions`: The set.

**Returns:** The outcome and its reason.

---

<a id="iconditionsource"></a>

## `IConditionSource`

interface · `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core.Conditions.IConditionSource` · assembly `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core`

Supplies the current values of the tokens it registered: the game-side provider (every built-in token) or a mod (its `<modId>/<name>` tokens). Called by the evaluator on the main thread.

<a id="iconditionsource--trygetvalues"></a>

### `bool TryGetValues(ConditionTokenInfo token, string argument, out IReadOnlyList<string> values)`

The token's current values as invariant text; a token may hold several (`scenery`, `hasPack`).

**Parameters**

- `token`: The registered token.
- `argument`: The clause's argument (`flag:<name>`), or null.
- `values`: The values; an empty list means "no value" (every Equal/Range/compare fails).

**Returns:** False when the value is not known yet (before the save loads): the result is [`ConditionOutcome.Unavailable`](#conditionoutcome--unavailable).

---

<a id="unavailableconditionevaluator"></a>

## `UnavailableConditionEvaluator`

sealed class · `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core.Conditions.UnavailableConditionEvaluator` · assembly `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core`

Implements: [`IConditionEvaluator`](#iconditionevaluator)

The evaluator before one is installed: an empty set is [`ConditionOutcome.Met`](#conditionoutcome--met) (nothing to check); anything else is [`ConditionOutcome.Unavailable`](#conditionoutcome--unavailable), so conditional content stays off rather than applying unchecked.

<a id="unavailableconditionevaluator--reason"></a>

### `const string Reason = "conditions are not available: no condition evaluator is installed"`

The reason text every unavailable answer carries.

<a id="unavailableconditionevaluator--instance"></a>

### `static UnavailableConditionEvaluator Instance { get; }`

The one instance.

<a id="unavailableconditionevaluator--evaluate"></a>

### `ConditionResult Evaluate(ConditionSet conditions)`

Evaluates every clause (AND). Must not throw; the registry still guards it.

**Parameters**

- `conditions`: The set.

**Returns:** The outcome and its reason.

<a id="updatepoint"></a>

## `UpdatePoint`

enum · `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core.Conditions.UpdatePoint` · assembly `CwyLs.ModLoader.Core` · mod API

The moments at which a condition's answer can change, so a consumer re-evaluates only when it matters (like the "update rate" of Stardew Valley's Content Patcher). A flags enum: a token lists every point that can change its value, and a [`ConditionSet`](#conditionset)'s points are the union of its tokens' ([`ConditionRegistry.UpdatePointsOf`](#conditionregistry--updatepointsof)).

The condition provider raises [`ConditionsChanged`](#conditionschanged) with exactly one point per change through [`ConditionRegistry.RaiseChanged`](#conditionregistry--raisechanged). Values are explicit and never renumbered.

| Name | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="updatepoint--none"></a>`None` | 0 | Never changes (a constant), or nothing changed. |
| <a id="updatepoint--startup"></a>`Startup` | 1 | The packs were read at startup. |
| <a id="updatepoint--roomready"></a>`RoomReady` | 2 | The room is up and the player's save is loaded (level, story and scenery become known). |
| <a id="updatepoint--daystarted"></a>`DayStarted` | 4 | The local calendar date changed (weekday, date, daily random roll). |
| <a id="updatepoint--timechanged"></a>`TimeChanged` | 8 | The local clock moved to a new minute (time, hour, time of day). |
| <a id="updatepoint--pomodorochanged"></a>`PomodoroChanged` | 16 | The pomodoro or count-up timer changed state. |
| <a id="updatepoint--languagechanged"></a>`LanguageChanged` | 32 | The display language changed. |
| <a id="updatepoint--scenerychanged"></a>`SceneryChanged` | 64 | A window view, the weather or the scenery changed. |
| <a id="updatepoint--storyprogressed"></a>`StoryProgressed` | 128 | A story scene ended or the story progress was saved. |
| <a id="updatepoint--levelchanged"></a>`LevelChanged` | 256 | The player's level changed. |
| <a id="updatepoint--flagchanged"></a>`FlagChanged` | 512 | A flag was set or cleared (`cwy.flag`, or a mod). |
| <a id="updatepoint--packschanged"></a>`PacksChanged` | 1024 | The packs were rescanned or reloaded. |
| <a id="updatepoint--modtoken"></a>`ModToken` | 2048 | A mod said one of its own tokens changed. |
| <a id="updatepoint--manual"></a>`Manual` | 4096 | Someone asked for a re-evaluation (console `cond override`, a test). |
| <a id="updatepoint--all"></a>`All` | 8191 | Every point: what an unknown token is assumed to depend on. |
